text.title: plan.md Structure — Worked Examples
text.summary: The Execution Plan table as it appears in a real plan.md, one correct skip and one wrong skip, and the empirical anchor for the merge — what was kept and what was dropped when design.md and implementation-plan.md became one file.

section.title: Execution Plan — waves and task table

example.code:
## Execution Plan
### Waves - Wave A (serial): T01 → T02 (T02 needs T01 migration). - Wave B (parallel): T03, T04, T05 (independent surfaces). - Wave C (serial): T06 (integration test against T03-T05).
### Tasks | ID | Description | Deps | Est. tokens | |-----|---------------------------------|---------|-------------| | T01 | Migration: add `verified_at` | — | ~3k | | T02 | Serializer: expose `verified` | T01 | ~2k | | T03 | Email service: send verify mail | — | ~5k | ...
example.note: Ids, dependencies and token estimates are what let an executor parallelise Wave B and resume after an interruption. Risks and Rollback follow as further `###` sub-sections.
Feature: "add `phone` field to user profile form". 1 migration + 1 form change + 1 test. Spec.md lists the three tasks as checkboxes. No plan.md.

Feature: "add Stripe webhook handler" — 6 tasks, new signature-verification contract, idempotency requirement. Skipping plan.md leaves the dependency graph unwritten and parallel execution impossible.

section.title: Why design + impl-plan were merged
section.p: The merge is empirical, not aesthetic. F021, F022, F002 each showed the two files cross-referencing on every section and drifting whenever one was updated alone. In F021 a schema decision in design.md changed late; implementation-plan.md still referenced the old shape; one task generated code against stale design. The fix landed in a second PR and burned a half-day reconciling. F022 and F002 reproduced the same pattern at different scales.

list.item: The DESIGN content — still required, just inside the same file.
The EXECUTION PLAN content — still required, same file.
Cross-references between them — now markdown anchors within plan.md, not cross-file links.
Separate file headers, separate frontmatter, separate version numbers.
The cross-file linking discipline that nobody actually followed.
